summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long ASTS Daily ETF (ASTG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of AST SpaceMobile, Inc. (ASTS) stock, less fees and expenses. ASTG was launched on Jun 23, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.

data.title: Leverage Shares by Themes Unveils Nine New 2X Single-Stock ETFs Tracking Key Players in the Technology Supply Chain
data.text: GREENWICH, Conn., June 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Leverage Shares by Themes is pleased to announce the launch of nine new 2X single-stock leveraged ETFs, available for trading beginning June 23, 2026.
